heroSub: AgroSentinel fuses crop history, soil moisture and weather trends to forecast stress 7 days ahead — and shows whether your intervention will actually help.
advIrrigateWhy: Soil moisture is low and little rain is expected.
advPest: Check leaves and stems for pests
advPestWhy: Crop vigor is dropping while water is adequate — pests are a likely cause.
advDelayFert: Delay fertilizer until after the coming rain
advDelayFertWhy: Heavy rain soon would wash away fertilizer before roots absorb it.
advMulch: Add mulch to hold soil moisture
advMulchWhy: Moisture is falling and temperatures are rising; mulch slows evaporation.
advShade: Consider shade netting during peak heat
advShadeWhy: The strong warming trend is the main driver of stress right now.
advMonitor: No action needed — keep monitoring weekly
advMonitorWhy: Stress is low and conditions are stable.
noLogs: No actions logged yet for this field.
alertHigh: High risk ahead: stress is forecast to cross the critical level within {days} days. Act now.
alertOk: No critical risk in the next 7 days.
previewOnly: Preview; integration planned — no real messages are sent.
evidenceText: We back-tested both approaches on a held-out split of 200 simulated fields. The single-snapshot model only sees today's crop vigor and assumes nothing changes. The time-series model reads 21 days of soil, weather and crop history. All metrics below are computed from that data, not assumed.
listenUnavailable: Read-aloud is not available on this device or network.
